question: Which book on Atal Bihari Vajpayee was released by Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanatan Sanskriti Ki Atal Drishti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan released the book “Sanatan Sanskriti Ki Atal Drishti” authored by Vasudev Devnani.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The book is authored by Vasudev Devnani**, the Speaker of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly.
 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee is portrayed as an institutional leader** who strengthened democratic traditions.
 
• **The Pokhran nuclear tests** are highlighted as symbols of a **self-confident and sovereign India**.
 
• **Vajpayee’s governance reforms** are noted for continuing to influence India’s development trajectory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee served as India’s Prime Minister three times** and is remembered for consensus-driven politics.
 
• **His birth anniversary, 25 December**, is observed as **Good Governance Day** in India.
 
• **The book links Sanatan cultural values** with Vajpayee’s political vision and statesmanship.
 
• **Pokhran-II nuclear tests were conducted in 1998**, significantly enhancing India’s strategic stature.
